configure_sphinx_autodoc: configure sphinx autodoc to include constructors, inheritance, and undocumented members for PyMomentum docs
setup_skip_pycapsule: set up a sphinx autodoc-skip-member hook to skip PyCapsule and avoid RST parsing warnings
configure_exclude_patterns: configure sphinx to exclude .pixi and build directories from documentation generation
configure_html_theme: configure sphinx to use the sphinx_rtd_theme for HTML documentation output
review_conf_py: review the sphinx conf.py configuration for the PyMomentum documentation build
